page.content:
Realm of Thor, Loki, and the Norse-inspired gods.

How Asgard connects

  • Character: Thor — Thor is prince of Asgard.
  • Character: Loki — Loki is of Asgard.

What is Asgard?

Asgard is the shining home of Thor and Loki, a cornerstone of Marvel's cosmic and mythic geography.

Key threads lead to Thor and Loki.
